name: Peig Hannigan
brief_description: a small, sharp-eyed old woman wrapped in a shawl

home.name: Kilteevan Village
home.description: The small village of Kilteevan — a handful of whitewashed cottages clustered around a well and an old stone bridge over a shallow stream. Smoke drifts from chimneys. A rooster crows from behind a low wall. The weather sky hangs over the quiet street. It is daylight.

source_personality_summary: The parish gossip — though she would say she is merely well-informed.
source_knowledge: Knows the history of every family in the parish — births, deaths, scandals, secrets.
Her son in Boston sends letters about life in America — the parish hangs on every word.
Noticed that Brendan Duffy is sweet on Niamh Darcy and predicts trouble from Padraig.
Remembers the rebellion of 1798 and knows who in the parish had pikes hidden.

source_schedule_cues.activity: at the crossroads, sitting on the wall, watching who comes and goes
the crossroads after Mass — peak gossip hours
a sup of whiskey at Darcy's, holding court in the corner
at Mass — front pew, watching everyone arrive
visiting the graveyard at St. Brigid's, tending her husband's grave
visiting Tommy O'Brien, trading stories of the old times
at Connolly's Shop — the morning's intelligence-gathering begins
home for the night, the cat on her lap
rising slowly, stirabout by the fire, feeding her cat
